anne: Quick Q  benefit billing team flagged an admin fee invoice from BrightLock that spans Apr-Jun. Payroll vendor change is May 1. Who should pay the quarter if invoice hits during cutover?

mark-finance: Usually the employer is billed and Finance pays. If billing dates cross vendors we invoice the quarter to Redwood and coordinate reconciliation with new vendor. Any vendor-specific proration?

harper-payroll: New vendor NimbusPay will begin remitting contributions on May 8. PayRollCo covers runs through Apr 30. For admin fees BrightLock expects a quarterly payment from the plan sponsor, not per-payroll. So vendor swap shouldn't change who pays, but we should confirm remittance contact.

zoe-records: BrightLock here  confirm: plan-level admin fee billed quarterly to the Employer invoice profile on file. If contact changes during migration send updated remit_to and billing_email fields. We can backdate payments if there's a dispute but prefer single invoice paid on due date.

anne: OK so Finance pays invoice as usual. Action: Finance to add NimbusPay remit contact once they onboard. Harper, please confirm whether any per-payroll items (participant fees withheld from pay) need special handling across May runs.

harper-payroll: There are two participant-level deductions for optional loan processing fees that PayRollCo withheld Apr 15. Nimbus will resume withholding May 8. We'll export a carry-forward file so participants aren't double-billed.

mark-finance: I'll process BrightLock invoice when it arrives. Harper, please send updated remit contact and any carry-forward file to billing@brightlock.com. I'll also note the expense in the migration spreadsheet.

zoe-records: Received. We'll reconcile on our side and confirm no duplicate charges. If you include the migration ID in the invoice memo we'll speed matching.

anne: Great. I'll update the vendor cutover checklist: add billing_contact update, carry-forward confirm, and a quick comms note for employees about loan fee timing. Closing once Nimbus contact is in the file.
